title: 第9章 少年已疯第10章 一阶伴生兽
slug: 万古第一神第7596章第三轮
content_zh:
“父亲！”
李紫峰心情前所未有的激动。
“表现不错。”
李炎枫道。
“是父亲指引得好。”
李紫峰连忙道。
现在正是揭晓结果的时刻，只见在万众瞩目之下，李炎枫面向全城，正式宣告道：“今日正式宣告，立李紫峰为世子，为离火城继承人。”
“紫峰，你纵使有今日成绩，也不可骄傲自满，往后的路谨言慎行，一步一个脚印。”
李炎枫眼中难得有一种自豪的光彩。
“恭喜城主，恭喜世子，双喜临门！
再加上炎黄令，三喜临门！”
城卫军统帅‘赵定’在听风楼上站立起来，带头恭贺。
所有人都在看着李炎枫，没有人注意到在角落之中，有一个白衣少年忽然站了起来，跳上了听风台！
“李天命！
他上去干什么？”
当人们看清楚那个少年的样子的时候，他们满脸错愕，连声音都抖了一下。
不管怎么说，这个身为离火城污点的少年，不应该出现在这个地方，尤其是他被废掉世子之位，而他的弟弟刚继承世子之位这样关键的时刻！
“他出现做什么？一点脑子都没有？”
“这样的人，你指望他能做出什么得体的事情？”
“城主应该会很生气吧，毕竟今天他大婚，幸好李天命那个病残母亲没来。”

“赶紧上去一个人把他拖走吧。”
在人们眼中，李天命似乎成了一个被剥夺世子之位，伤心欲绝失去理智的人了。
但，他们低估了李天命。
他今天根本就不是为了世子之位，他对这个位置，对整个离火城，都没有任何留恋。
当他抬起头的时候，李炎枫已经回头，他眯了眯眼睛，下一个瞬间，便有一股恐怖的气势镇压在李天命的身上。
眼前的李炎枫好像直接变成一头遮天蔽日的巨兽，居高临下冷漠的看着自己。
若是十几天之前，李天命恐怕会直接趴倒在地上，连动弹都困难。
但现在，他可是太古混沌巨兽的御兽师，光是在气势镇压之上，哪怕对方实力再强，血脉上的尊贵还是能够让他撑住，就算眼前的路如同在泥沼之中，他都坚持走到李炎枫眼前！
“你疯了吧！
来人，赶紧把他撵下去，乞讨的都跑这里来了。”
旁边李紫峰的脸色阴沉了下去。
听到李紫峰的吩咐，立刻便有不少护卫上来，其中便有满头大汗的马超渊，毕竟他今天是守门人。
只是李炎枫摆摆手，便让那些护卫退下了。
“天命，安心养病就好了，来这里做什么，紫峰有这样的前程，作为兄长，你可以选择支持他。”
李炎枫道。
“紫峰不错，修炼很有天分，比当初的我强，不过在他得到炎黄令之前，我想再给他加一重考验。”
李天命的语气很平淡，他并没有如人们想象那样失去神智，歇斯底里。
他们父子平等交谈，暗潮汹涌，但至少没有撕破脸，让场面变得很难看，传为笑话。
今天是大喜的日子，脸面最重要，听风楼上，还有一些来自其他城池，来自焱都，甚至来自雷尊府的朋友呢。
“李天命，你在开什么玩笑呢？你就是一坨烂泥，你还给我增加考验？”

李紫峰道。
“大喜的日子，说话要有素质。
content_en:
"Father!"
Li Zifeng felt more excited than ever before.
"Performing well."
Li Yanfeng said.
"My father guided me well."
Li Zifeng said quickly.
Now is the moment to reveal the results. Under the gaze of everyone, Li Yanfeng faced the whole city and officially announced: "Today, we officially declare that Li Zifeng is the crown prince and the heir to Lihuo City."
"Zifeng, even if you have achieved today's results, you must not be arrogant and complacent. You should be cautious in your words and deeds in the future, one step at a time."
There was a rare gleam of pride in Li Yanfeng's eyes.
“Congratulations to the city lord, congratulations to the crown prince, double happiness!
Coupled with the Yanhuang Order, three blessings are coming! "
The commander of the city guard, Zhao Ding, stood up on Tingfeng Tower and took the lead in congratulations.
Everyone was looking at Li Yanfeng, but no one noticed that in the corner, a young man in white suddenly stood up and jumped onto the listening platform!
"Li Tianming!
What was he doing up there? "
When people saw the young man's appearance clearly, their faces were filled with astonishment, and even their voices trembled.
In any case, this young man with a stain on Lihuo City should not appear in this place, especially at such a critical moment when he was deposed as the crown prince and his younger brother just inherited the title!
"What's he doing here? No brains at all?"
"What kind of decent things do you expect from such a person?"
"The city lord should be very angry. After all, he is getting married today. Fortunately, Li Tianming's sick and disabled mother did not come."
"Hurry up and drag him away alone."
In people's eyes, Li Tianming seemed to have become a man who was deprived of his position as heir apparent, heartbroken and lost his mind.
However, they underestimated Li Tianming.
He is not here for the position of prince today at all. He has no nostalgia for this position or for the entire Lihuo City.
When he raised his head, Li Yanfeng had already turned back. He squinted his eyes. The next moment, a terrifying aura suppressed Li Tianming.
Li Yanfeng in front of him seemed to have turned into a giant beast that covered the sky and the sun, looking at him condescendingly and indifferently.
If it had been more than ten days ago, Li Tianming would have fallen to the ground, and it would be difficult to even move.
But now, he is the master of the ancient chaotic beast. Just by suppressing his aura, no matter how strong the opponent is, the nobility of his blood can still keep him going. Even if the road in front of him is like a quagmire, he insists on walking to Li Yanfeng!
"Are you crazy!
If someone comes, throw him out quickly. All the beggars are here. "
Li Zifeng's face turned gloomy next to him.
After hearing Li Zifeng's order, many guards came up immediately, including Ma Chaoyuan who was sweating profusely. After all, he was the gatekeeper today.
Li Yanfeng just waved his hand and asked the guards to retreat.
"Destiny, just rest in peace and recuperate. What are you doing here? Zifeng has such a future. As an elder brother, you can choose to support him."
Li Yanfeng said.
"Zifeng is not bad. He is very talented in training and is better than me at the beginning. But before he gets the Yanhuang Order, I want to give him another test."
Li Tianming's tone was very calm. He did not lose his mind or become hysterical as people imagined.
The father and son talked as equals, and the undercurrent was turbulent, but at least they did not break up, making the scene ugly and passed down as a joke.
Today is a big day, and face is the most important thing. There are some friends from other cities, from Yandu, and even from Lei Zun Mansion in Tingfeng Tower.
"Li Tianming, are you kidding me? You are just a piece of mud, and you are giving me more tests?"
Li Zifeng said.
“On a special day, speak with quality.
